basics.type: State private university, the first in Himachal Pradesh (H.P. State Legislature Act No. 14 of 2002)
basics.ugc: Approved by UGC under Section 2(f) of the UGC Act
basics.other: B.Tech in AI & Data Science, AI & Machine Learning, Biotechnology, Bioinformatics, Civil, CSE and its specialisations, ECE and IT; Biotechnology accredited by NBA

admission: 60% aggregate in Class 12 (55% for SC/ST); merit counts Physics, Maths and one more high-scoring subject
Merit through JEE Main 2026 or Class 12 marks, then counselling. Half of the 855 seats are filled on Class 12 marks.

scholarships.text: First-year merit scholarship of 20% to 40% of tuition for Class 12 scores from 60% to above 90% (not for CSE, its specialisations, AI-ML, AI-DS and IT); kept with a CGPA of 7.0. A merit-cum-means waiver of one semester's tuition a year is open to all B.Tech students with family income below ₹8 lakh.

hostel.text: Optional hostel at ₹84,000 a semester; a single room adds ₹8,000 a semester.

fees.text: B.Tech tuition is ₹1,64,550 a semester (general category), plus one-time admission charges of ₹25,000 and refundable caution money of ₹20,000.

desc: Jaypee University of Information Technology, Waknaghat (Solan): B.Tech admission through JEE Main or Class 12 marks, 2026-27 fees, scholarships and hostel.
